item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00322","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C11","C09","C19"],"selected_candidate_label":"C11","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C11 supplies the child's distinctive two-part drafting machinery: recitals first identify newly effective Schedule XX concessions and then determine a consequential amendment to the Cuba list; the operative provisions separately implement those two determinations under headings PART I and PART II. The child closely adapts that sequence to Greece's accession under the Annecy Protocol and to different tariff items. C09 is also a strong direct source because the child expressly supplements it and repeats its Annecy-specific language, while C19 uses the same broader accession-and-Cuba-adjustment structure, but C11 is the closest reusable template for the child's compact two-part form.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas I determine that the application of each of the concessions provided for in Part I of Schedule XX in Annex A ... is required or appropriate to carry out, on and after March 9, 1950, the said trade agreement for accession","parent_excerpt":"Whereas ... determine that the application of each of the concessions provided for in part I of schedule XX ... is required or appropriate to carry out, on and after the date set forth following the identification of each such concession, said trade agreement","explanation":"Distinctive parallel determination activating previously withheld Schedule XX concessions upon a country's becoming a contracting party."},{"child_excerpt":"Whereas I determine that, in view of the determination set forth in the sixth recital ... the deletion of Item 328 from the list set forth in the ninth recital of the said proclamation of January 1, 1948 ... is required or appropriate to carry out ... the said exclusive trade agreement","parent_excerpt":"And Whereas, I determine that, in view of the determination set forth in the 6th recital ... The deletion ... of item 758 ... [and] item 762 in said 9th recital ... [is] required or appropriate to carry out said exclusive trade agreement","explanation":"The child closely follows C11's linked second determination: activation of general-agreement concessions triggers deletions from the Cuba proclamation's ninth-recital list."},{"child_excerpt":"PART I To the end that the said trade agreement for accession ... may be carried out ... PART II To the end that the said exclusive trade agreement ... may be carried out, the list set forth in the ninth recital ... shall ... be further amended by deleting therefrom the Item 328","parent_excerpt":"PART I To the end that said trade agreement ... may be carried out ... PART II To the end that said exclusive trade agreement ... may be carried out, that the list set forth in the 9th recital ... shall be further amended in the manner ... indicated in the 7th recital","explanation":"Nearly identical two-part operative architecture separates implementation of the multilateral agreement from the corresponding amendment of the Cuba list."}]}
